candidates.name: @prometheus-ags/prometheus-entity-management 3.0.2

evidence.claim: The exact release source contains the reproduced N+2 list-publication defect.
The signed v3.0.2 tag matches the defective published path.

candidates.decision_rationale: Adopt immediately to replace the current workspace 3.0.0-rc.1 resolution and satisfy the dependency goal; also retain as the upstream notification-count negative-control baseline.

candidates.name: Atomic fetched-list ingestion in Entity Graph Core
candidates.fit_for_gap: Makes fetched-row data, lifecycle metadata, sync metadata, and list metadata one Zustand publication independent of row count.
risks: A broad transaction abstraction would expand scope; cover existing fetched-list semantics only.
All list-fetch callers must migrate or an alternate path retains the defect.
candidates.decision_rationale: No current package API provides atomic fetched-list ingestion, and createGraphTransaction is rollback-only.

candidates.name: Prometheus Entity Management corrected patch release
candidates.fit_for_gap: Supplies the requested release package plus the required atomic-ingestion correction without a UAR-private fork.
candidates.decision_rationale: Adopt when published, but do not block UAR's configured-twelve-model path or exact 3.0.2 migration while upstream work proceeds.

candidates.name: Graph-owned AgentSessionDraft entity
candidates.fit_for_gap: Keeps unsaved business configuration explicit and inspectable without exposing it as committed AgentSession data.
risks: Canonical patches would leak unsaved values to all subscribers.
A whole-draft selector would still rerender the entire panel; subscriptions must be field-level.
candidates.decision_rationale: A distinct draft identity matches the no-hidden-business-state rule while preserving commit/cancel isolation.

candidates.name: React 19 external-store semantics

evidence.claim: A subscriber rerenders when the external-store snapshot changes by Object.is.
Derived state and identity boundaries replace unnecessary synchronization; isolated drafts can be legitimate.

candidates.decision_rationale: Use to reject both render-phase synchronization and the unsupported zero-rerender premise.

candidates.name: Zustand 5 stable narrow selectors
candidates.fit_for_gap: Limits rerenders to subscribers whose selected field or list changed.
risks: Selectors cannot repair an upstream mutation loop; atomic ingestion comes first.
candidates.decision_rationale: Use field-level draft selectors and stable list snapshots after correcting state ownership.

candidates.name: @playwright/test 1.62.1
candidates.fit_for_gap: Provides one short local installed-service proof of responsiveness, network bounds, persistence, effective inference, cancel isolation, and computed spacing.
candidates.decision_rationale: It is already installed and observes the actual failure mode without a new framework.

candidates.name: Vercel React Best Practices and Composition Patterns
candidates.fit_for_gap: Supplies React rerender, derived-state, iteration-cost, and component-boundary guidance.
candidates.decision_rationale: Reference in standing instructions and back with scoped static/architecture gates.

candidates.name: New query/cache library
candidates.decision_rationale: It would duplicate the graph and would not repair list publication or the dead facade.

candidates.name: Shared canonical patches for unsaved form state
candidates.decision_rationale: Shared overlays would expose uncommitted draft values to unrelated subscribers.

build_required.need: Atomic fetched-list ingestion in upstream core and React binding
build_required.why_no_candidate: No 3.0.2 API combines row merge, fetched lifecycle, sync metadata, and list result in one publication.

build_required.need: UAR domain transports and hooks for configured providers/models and AgentSession
build_required.why_no_candidate: These are application-specific REST contracts behind UAR's platform boundary.
Shared patches and the component-local CRUD buffer do not meet UAR's inspectable-business-state constraint.

build_required.need: Typed session configuration through effective inference
build_required.why_no_candidate: The frontend/backend mismatch and policy path are UAR behavior.

build_required.need: Scoped React/entity architecture gates and standing instructions
build_required.why_no_candidate: Project boundaries require local enforcement and named skill routing.
